notes: New Hope Liuhe (SZSE: 000876) — second-largest Chinese animal feed producer + integrated pork business (~15M head/yr). Three core segments: feed (40%+ of revenue, branded Liuhe), hog farming, and food/processed meats. Reports CNY-millions PRC GAAP. Lists in CNY on Shenzhen Stock Exchange. FY ends Dec 31. Hog cycle exposure (lower vs Muyuan due to feed buffer). Net debt = interest-bearing total debt − cash & marketable securities.

periods.notes: FY20: Peak hog prices + feed volume growth. Revenue RMB109.9bn (+33%), EBITDA RMB11.25bn (margin 10.2%), NI RMB4.94bn.
FY21: Disaster year — hog price crash + biological asset writedowns + heavy expansion capex. Revenue RMB126.3bn (+15%), EBITDA -RMB3.2bn, NI -RMB9.6bn (record loss). Leverage ballooned.
FY22: Recovery — feed segment stable, hog prices recovered 2H22. Revenue RMB139.1bn (+10%), EBITDA RMB6.85bn (margin 4.9%), NI ~RMB25M (breakeven).
FY23: Trough cycle — hog losses + feed gross margin compressed. Revenue RMB141.8bn, EBITDA RMB1.45bn (margin 1.0%), NI -RMB2.95bn. Asset divestments reduced debt.
FY24: Revenue RMB103bn (-27% on poultry/feed divestments + lower volumes); hog cycle improved. EBITDA RMB5.3bn (margin 5.1%), NI RMB487M (back to profit). Net debt down to RMB33bn (~6.3x).
